001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Written as a bolus completes, recording the insulin the pump adds to its IOB for that bolus.
009 * Tandem publishes no name for opcode 195, so this class name is provisional. Bytes 12-13 were
010 * zero in every record observed. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.
011 */
012@HistoryLogProps(
013    opCode = 195,
014    displayName = "Bolus IOB Entry"
015)
016public class BolusIobEntryHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
017
018    private int unknownU8At10;
019    private int unknownU8At11;
020    private long insulinDurationMillis;
021    private float insulinDelivered;
022    private float mudaliarIob;
023
024    public BolusIobEntryHistoryLog() {}
025
026    public BolusIobEntryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, long insulinDurationMillis, float insulinDelivered, float mudaliarIob) {
027        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknownU8At10, unknownU8At11, insulinDurationMillis, insulinDelivered, mudaliarIob, 0);
028    }
029
030    public BolusIobEntryHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, long insulinDurationMillis, float insulinDelivered, float mudaliarIob, int headerHighNibble) {
031        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
032        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknownU8At10, unknownU8At11, insulinDurationMillis, insulinDelivered, mudaliarIob, headerHighNibble);
033        this.unknownU8At10 = unknownU8At10;
034        this.unknownU8At11 = unknownU8At11;
035        this.insulinDurationMillis = insulinDurationMillis;
036        this.insulinDelivered = insulinDelivered;
037        this.mudaliarIob = mudaliarIob;
038    }
039
040    public int typeId() {
041        return 195;
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * <table border="1">
046     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusIobEntryHistoryLog:</caption>
047     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At10</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
048     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
049     * <tr><td><code>insulinDurationMillis</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
050     * <tr><td><code>insulinDelivered</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>mudaliarIob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
052     * </table>
053     */
054    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
055        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
056        this.cargo = raw;
057        parseBase(raw);
058        this.unknownU8At10 = raw[10] & 0xFF;
059        this.unknownU8At11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
060        this.insulinDurationMillis = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
061        this.insulinDelivered = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
062        this.mudaliarIob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
063    }
064
065    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int unknownU8At10, int unknownU8At11, long insulinDurationMillis, float insulinDelivered, float mudaliarIob, int headerHighNibble) {
066        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
067            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(195, headerHighNibble),
068            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
069            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
070            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At10, (byte) unknownU8At11, 0, 0 },
071            Bytes.toUint32(insulinDurationMillis),
072            Bytes.toFloat(insulinDelivered),
073            Bytes.toFloat(mudaliarIob)));
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * @return byte 10. 0 when insulin was delivered; 1 in the records for boluses that delivered
078     * nothing, which also carry 0xFF in byte 11, 0xFFFFFFFF as the duration and zero floats.
079     */
080    public int getUnknownU8At10() {
081        return unknownU8At10;
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * @return byte 11. Unconfirmed, but it behaves like a slot index into the pump's table of
086     * boluses still on board: values stay small, and in about 97% of records it is the lowest
087     * index not taken by a bolus completed less than {@link #getInsulinDurationMillis()} earlier.
088     * 0xFF when nothing was delivered.
089     */
090    public int getUnknownU8At11() {
091        return unknownU8At11;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * @return the insulin duration applied to this bolus, in milliseconds. It matched the active
096     * profile's IDP insulinDuration setting (4, 5, 6 and 8 hours seen). 0xFFFFFFFF when nothing
097     * was delivered.
098     */
099    public long getInsulinDurationMillis() {
100        return insulinDurationMillis;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * @return units delivered; equal to {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog#getInsulinDelivered()} bit
105     * for bit
106     */
107    public float getInsulinDelivered() {
108        return insulinDelivered;
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * @return Mudaliar IOB in units after adding this bolus; equal to
113     * {@link IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog#getMudaliarIob()} bit for bit. This is the pump's
114     * displayed IOB only when it displays the Mudaliar model (selectedIob 0).
115     */
116    public float getMudaliarIob() {
117        return mudaliarIob;
118    }
119}
